params.implementations: Verifier versions and their corresponding contracts.
Destination chain selectors and their corresponding verifier contracts.

getInboundImplementation(bytes).details: The OffRamp is responsible for calling this function using the verifierResults it receives from the executor. If the verifier specified by the executor is actually a resolver, the OffRamp will call this function to get the actual verifier contract. Verifiers can build resolvers that process the verifierResults in accordance with how their verifier forms verifierResults. For example, their verifier may prefix the verifierResults with a version identifier, which the resolver can parse to determine the correct verifier contract.

params.verifierResults: The verifierResults formed by the verifier.

returns._0: verifierAddress The address of the verifier contract.

getOutboundImplementation(uint64,bytes).details: The OnRamp is responsible for calling this function using the destChainSelector specified by the sender. If the verifier specified by the sender is actually a resolver, the OnRamp will call this function to get the actual verifier contract. For example, resolvers can maintain a simple mapping of destChainSelector to verifier contract address.

params.extraArgs: Extra arguments that can be used by the resolver to determine the correct verifier contract.

returns._0: verifierAddress The address of the verifier contract.

setFeeAggregator(address).details: FeeTokenHandler will revert if feeAggregator is zero when withdrawing fees.A zero address fee aggregator is valid, and intentionally reverts calls to withdraw fee tokens.

params.feeAggregator: The address of the new fee aggregator contract.

params.to: The address to which ownership will be transferred.

acceptOwnership().notice: Allows an ownership transfer to be completed by the recipient.

getFeeAggregator().notice: Returns the address of the fee aggregator.

getInboundImplementation(bytes).notice: Returns the appropriate verifier contract based on the given verifierResults.

getOutboundImplementation(uint64,bytes).notice: Returns the appropriate verifier contract based on the given destChainSelector.

setFeeAggregator(address).notice: Sets the address of the fee aggregator.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Allows an owner to begin transferring ownership to a new address. The new owner needs to call `acceptOwnership` to accept the transfer before any permissions are changed.

withdrawFeeTokens(address[]).notice: Withdraws the outstanding fee token balances to the fee aggregator.
